title: MB&SP 4.0 — more than an electronics store
author: Miłosz
content:
Today MB&SP 4.0 enters Early Access.

It’s a moment I have been working toward for a long time. But the launch of the new version is not just a new site, a new look, or more features.

It is the next stage of what MB&SP is meant to be.

MB&SP started from a fairly simple premise: I want to create a place where buying electronic components is as simple, clear, and convenient as possible — both when someone needs a single part for their own project and when they are ordering a larger number of components.

But I don’t want to build yet another impersonal store with thousands of products.

I want to build a platform I would want to visit myself as a customer.

Why does MB&SP actually exist?

Electronics has always been one of the foundations of my interests. MB&SP came about precisely from that perspective.

I know what it’s like to search for a specific component, compare offers, check parameters, or put together the parts needed for a project. I also know that the product alone isn’t everything.

What also matters is how easily you can find it, order it, and later receive it.

That is why I develop MB&SP not just as a product catalog, but as an entire process — from finding the right component, through placing the order, all the way to shipping it.

Why buy on MB&SP?

First of all, because MB&SP is built with electronics users in mind.

We aren’t trying to be everything to everyone.

We focus on components, modules, and products that can be useful when building, repairing, or developing your own projects.

At the same time, I keep working to make using the platform more and more convenient.

The new version of MB&SP gives me far greater room for further development. Thanks to that, new features don’t have to be the end of the road — they can be the beginning of further improvements.

And that is what matters most to me.

MB&SP is meant to grow together with its users.

A small store, a big approach

MB&SP is not a huge marketplace.

And for now it doesn’t need to be.

Behind the platform stands a real person who is responsible for its development, the products, customer service, and the entire process behind an order.

That matters.

To me, every order is more than just another number in the system. It’s a sign that someone found something they needed on MB&SP, trusted the platform, and decided to shop right here.

That is why it’s important to me that shipping itself is part of that experience.

From preparing the order, through protecting the products, to the moment the package reaches the customer.

It may sound like a detail.

To me, it isn’t.

What’s next?

MB&SP 4.0 is only the beginning of the next stage.

Early Access does not mean the project is finished.

It means it is ready to start working in practice.

Now the most important thing will be to observe how the platform performs in real use, what customers need, and what else I can improve.

There will be more features. More products. More improvements.

But the foundation will stay the same:

to build my own platform, develop it step by step, and create a place where electronics is simply easier.

Today we begin the next chapter.

MB&SP 4.0 Early Access — 09/26/2026.

See you on MB&SP.

Miłosz Boguniewicz
MB&SP / Mily Unlimited
